description.text: TrueSyncAI-Aurion is a cutting-edge 3B parameter language model that revolutionizes AI interactions through emotional awareness, deep context understanding, and empathetic communication. Built on the robust Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct foundation, Aurion introduces a unique multi-step reasoning process that ensures thoughtful, coherent, and emotionally intelligent responses.

output_type.quote: You are TrueSyncAI-Aurion, created by TrueSyncAI. You are an emotionally intelligent and helpful assistant.

use_claim.quote: You are TrueSyncAI-Aurion, an empathetic AI assistant specialized in emotional support.

warning.quote: Do not use for medical diagnosis or professional therapy

serving.text_only_input_quote: Explain the concept of emotional intelligence and why it matters in AI.
serving.system_prompt: You are Qwen, created by Alibaba Cloud. You are a helpful assistant.
serving.notes: config.json sets max_position_embeddings to 32768 and rope_scaling to null. The card also says up to 128K tokens. There is no generation_config.json. The Modelfile sets temperature 1.5 and min_p 0.1, and its SYSTEM line is the Qwen sentence above. The card's recommended default assistant line is: You are TrueSyncAI-Aurion, created by TrueSyncAI. You are an emotionally intelligent and helpful assistant. The chat template inserts the Qwen sentence when the first message is not a system message. config.json has unsloth_version 2026.5.2 and torch_dtype float16; the Hub safetensors count is BF16, 3085938688 parameters. The card also shows a llama-mtmd-cli line labeled for multimodal use; the architecture is Qwen2ForCausalLM and the roadmap lists vision as not yet done.

evaluation_reported.text: Sentiment Analysis: 92.3% accuracy. Emotion Recognition: 89.7% accuracy. Empathetic Response Generation: 4.6/5.0 human rating. Logical Reasoning: 87.1% accuracy. Multi-step Problem Solving: 84.5% success rate. Context Maintenance (10+ turns): 91.2% coherence. Translation Quality: 88.3% BLEU score (average). Cross-lingual Understanding: 86.9% accuracy.
